plugin.name: Solao_Loot_Tracker
plugin.author: Solao
plugin.purpose: Records mob loot (item, mob, zone, room) into a searchable SQLite database

muclient.script:
require "gmcphelper" require "json" -- json.encode / json.decode (bundled) local ok_colors = pcall(require, "aardwolf_colors") -- StylesToColours pcall(function () async = require "async" end) -- global; async HTTP for the share API
local TITLE = "Loot Tracker" local PVER = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 19) or "?"
-- shared loot-pool service. Baked in, not user-changeable. local API_URL = "https://api.aardwolf.muds.fyi"
local DBFILE local db
-- auto-send 'id' on every corpse loot. Needs the identify wish to return anything -- useful, so it stays off until you have it ('loot autoid on'). The parser itself -- always runs -- a shop 'appraise' fills the DB with no wish and no extra traffic. local cfg_autoid = false local cfg_idnote = true -- print a line when stats get stored
local function trim (s) return (s or ""):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","") end local function q (s) return "'" .. tostring(s or ""):gsub("'", "''") .. "'" end
-- 'get from' can be a room resource (a bush, a chest) OR your own bag. We only -- want room resources, so any source containing one of these words is treated as -- a personal container and ignored. Editable with 'loot bags add|del'. local exclude = {} local EXCLUDE_DEFAULT = "bag,backpack,pouch,sack,satchel,purse,quiver,holding,pack,wallet,keyring" local function load_exclude () exclude = {} for word in (GetVariable("bags") or EXCLUDE_DEFAULT):gmatch("[^,]+") do local w = trim(word):lower() if w ~= "" then exclude[w] = true end end end local function save_exclude () local t = {}; for w in pairs(exclude) do t[#t+1] = w end table.sort(t); SetVariable("bags", table.concat(t, ",")) end local function is_bag (source) local low = source:lower() for w in pairs(exclude) do if low:find(w, 1, true) then return true end end return false end
-- Bonus-loot variants ('help gameload'). A mob-reset item can roll random stats -- and gets a flag welded onto its name: "(Polished) Runed Jade Bracer". The flag -- is a per-kill dice roll, not a different item, so for provenance (what drops -- where) the base name is what we want -- otherwise every roll spawns a new row. -- -- Can't just strip any leading (Word): plenty of real names start that way -- -- (Seekers) Elixir of Free Movement, (Aarchaeology) ..., and shops sell a -- (Legendary) Bracers of the Warrior-Poet that has nothing to do with the bonus -- tier of the same name. So two signals have to agree: -- 1. the word is a known flag, and -- 2. the bracket colour matches the tier it belongs to. -- -- The tiers, by bracket colour: -- @W((@RGodly@W)) white, doubled -- @Y(@WDivine@Y) Mythical Fabled Epic Legendary -- @R(@WEternal@R) Exalted Majestic Wondrous Radiant -- @G(@WBrilliant@G) Dazzling Shimmering Gleaming Sparkling -- @G(@WVibrant@G) Shiny Burnished Enhanced Polished -- -- That colour check is what saves the shop row: its Legendary is @W(@MLegendary@W) -- -- white brackets, magenta word -- so it is left alone. If no colour was -- captured at all, the curated word list decides on its own. -- -- NOT applied to shop_stock (shops sell fixed stock; bonus rolls only happen on -- mob-reset loot) or item_stats (a bonus item's stats are inflated -- filing them -- under the base name would poison the base item with one lucky roll). local bonus_flags = {} local BONUS_DEFAULT = table.concat({ "godly", "divine","mythical","fabled","epic","legendary", "eternal","exalted","majestic","wondrous","radiant", "brilliant","dazzling","shimmering","gleaming","sparkling", "vibrant","shiny","burnished","enhanced","polished", }, ",") local function load_flags () bonus_flags = {} for word in (GetVariable("bonusflags") or BONUS_DEFAULT):gmatch("[^,]+") do local w = trim(word):lower():gsub("[%(%)]", "") if w ~= "" then bonus_flags[w] = true end end end local function save_flags () local t = {}; for w in pairs(bonus_flags) do t[#t+1] = w end table.sort(t); SetVariable("bonusflags", table.concat(t, ",")) end
-- Drop a "@Y2@w * " count off the front of a coloured name. Only when everything -- before the '*' is colour codes and digits, so a '*' inside a real name is safe. local function strip_count_colour (c) local star = c:find("%*") if not star then return c end local head = c:sub(1, star - 1):gsub("@%a", "") if head:match("^%s*%d+%s*$") then return trim(c:sub(star + 1)) end return c end
-- strip stacked-pickup count and any bonus flag. citem is the @-coded name. local function base_name (item, citem) item = trim(item or "") local coloured = (citem and citem ~= "") and citem or nil
-- "2 * the body armor of ..." -- the game's stacked-pickup syntax, never a name. -- A stack CAN be of bonus items ("2 * (Polished) Sword"), so the colour has to -- lose the count too or the bracket check below looks at the wrong place. local stripped = item:gsub("^%d+%s*%*%s*", "") if stripped ~= item then item = trim(stripped) if coloured then coloured = strip_count_colour(coloured) end end -- ((Godly)) is doubled and white-bracketed local word, rest = item:match("^%(%((%a+)%)%)%s*(.*)$") if word and bonus_flags[word:lower()] then if (not coloured) or coloured:match("^@W%(%(") then return trim(rest) end return item end -- every other tier is a single (Word) in yellow, red or green brackets word, rest = item:match("^%((%a+)%)%s*(.*)$") if word and bonus_flags[word:lower()] and rest ~= "" then if (not coloured) or coloured:match("^@[YRG]%(") then return trim(rest) end end return item end
-- the reliable check: your inventory containers, read live from invdata (rename- -- proof). {invitem}serial,flags,shortdesc,type... where type 11 == a container. -- my_bags[shortdesc:lower()] = true. A source you 'get from' that is one of these -- is your own bag; anything else is a room object. local my_bags = {} -- shortdesc -> serial for everything you carry. 'id <serial>' is the only reliable -- way to identify a specific item, since names aren't keywords. local inv_serial = {} function on_invitem (name, line, wildcards) local parts = {} for p in (wildcards[1] .. ","):gmatch("(.-),") do parts[#parts+1] = p end local n = #parts if n < 7 then return end -- serial,flags,desc,level,type,+3 values local d = {} for i = 3, n - 5 do d[#d+1] = parts[i] end -- desc may itself contain commas local desc = trim(table.concat(d, ",")) if desc == "" then return end inv_serial[desc:lower()] = trim(parts[1]) if tonumber(parts[n-3]) == 11 then my_bags[desc:lower()] = true end -- 11 = container end
------------------------------------------------------------------ -- database ------------------------------------------------------------------ local function opendb () db = sqlite3.open(DBFILE) db:exec [[ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loot ( item TEXT NOT NULL, item_color TEXT, mob TEXT NOT NULL, zone TEXT, roomid INTEGER, room TEXT, count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, last_seen INTEGER, synced INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (item, mob) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shop_stock ( item TEXT NOT NULL, item_color TEXT, keeper TEXT, zone TEXT, roomid INTEGER, room TEXT, price INTEGER, level INTEGER, last_seen INTEGER, synced INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (item, roomid) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gathered ( item TEXT NOT NULL, item_color TEXT, source TEXT NOT NULL, zone TEXT, roomid INTEGER, room TEXT, count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, last_seen INTEGER, synced INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (item, source, roomid) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS item_stats ( item TEXT NOT NULL, item_color TEXT, keywords TEXT, type TEXT, level INTEGER, worth INTEGER, weight INTEGER, score INTEGER, wearable TEXT, material TEXT, flags TEXT, found_at TEXT, clan_item TEXT, owned_by TEXT, leads_to TEXT, notes TEXT, weapon_type TEXT, ave_dam INTEGER, specials TEXT, inflicts TEXT, dam_type TEXT, spells TEXT, capacity INTEGER, str INTEGER, intel INTEGER, wis INTEGER, dex INTEGER, con INTEGER, luck INTEGER, hp INTEGER, mana INTEGER, moves INTEGER, hit INTEGER, dam INTEGER, all_phys INTEGER, all_magic INTEGER, acid INTEGER, air INTEGER, bash INTEGER, cold INTEGER, disease INTEGER, earth INTEGER, electric INTEGER, energy INTEGER, fire INTEGER, holy INTEGER, light INTEGER, magic INTEGER, mental INTEGER, negative INTEGER, pierce INTEGER, poison INTEGER, shadow INTEGER, slash INTEGER, sonic INTEGER, water INTEGER, full_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_id INTEGER, synced INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (item) ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_loot_item ON loot(item); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_loot_mob ON loot(mob); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shop_item ON shop_stock(item); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_gath_item ON gathered(item); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_item ON item_stats(item); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stat_type ON item_stats(type); ]] -- upgrade older DBs (each ALTER is a no-op-or-error if the column exists) for _, a in ipairs({ "ALTER TABLE shop_stock ADD COLUMN level INTEGER;", "ALTER TABLE loot ADD COLUMN item_color TEXT;", "ALTER TABLE shop_stock ADD COLUMN item_color TEXT;", -- synced: 0 = the pool hasn't got this version of the row yet. Local-only, -- never sent over the wire. Existing rows come in as 0 so the first sync -- after upgrading still pushes everything once. "ALTER TABLE loot ADD COLUMN synced INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;", "ALTER TABLE shop_stock ADD COLUMN synced INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;", "ALTER TABLE gathered ADD COLUMN synced INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;", "ALTER TABLE item_stats ADD COLUMN synced INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;", }) do pcall(function () db:exec(a) end) end for _, t in ipairs({ "loot", "shop_stock", "gathered", "item_stats" }) do pcall(function () db:exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_"..t.."_synced ON "..t.."(synced);") end) end end
-- do we already have a full appraisal for this item? local function have_full_id (item) for r in db:nrows("SELECT full_id FROM item_stats WHERE item=" .. q(item)) do return r.full_id == 1 end return false end
-- Auto-identify freshly looted gear. Off by default (needs the identify wish), and -- it never fires while you're flagged AFK -- same rule as every other send we make. -- Deferred a tick because the {invitem} carrying the serial can arrive after the -- "You get" line. Items we already have a full appraisal for are skipped, so a -- farming run doesn't re-id the same drop over and over. local autoid_q = {} local function queue_autoid (item) if not cfg_autoid or item == "" then return end if GetVariable("AFKMode") ~= nil then return end if have_full_id(item) then return end autoid_q[#autoid_q+1] = item DoAfterSpecial(1, "drain_autoid()", sendto.script) end
function drain_autoid () local item = table.remove(autoid_q, 1) if not item then return end local serial = inv_serial[item:lower()] if serial then Send("id " .. serial) end -- no serial means it's already gone end
-- pull the coloured (@-coded) run of the item out of a matched line's styles local function colored_from (styles, pat) if not (ok_colors and StylesToColours) then return "" end local ok, full = pcall(StylesToColours, styles) if not ok or type(full) ~= "string" then return "" end return trim(full:match(pat) or "") end
-- print an @-coded string with its colours rendered. ColourNote takes colour names, -- not @ codes, so a stored item_color has to go out through ANSI. local function note_colored (s, plain) if s and s ~= "" and ok_colors and ColoursToANSI then local ok = pcall(function () AnsiNote(ColoursToANSI(s)) end) if ok then return end end ColourNote("cyan","", plain or s or "") end
-- current room from GMCP local function room_now () return trim(gmcp("room.info.zone") or ""), tonumber(gmcp("room.info.num")) or 0, trim(gmcp("room.info.name") or "") end
------------------------------------------------------------------ -- capture ------------------------------------------------------------------ function on_loot (name, line, wildcards, styles) local item, mob = trim(wildcards[1]), trim(wildcards[2]) if item:match("^[%d,]+ gold coins?$") then return end -- gold isn't loot (commas too) if item == "" or mob == "" then return end -- mob short-descs always lead with an article (a/an/the); player corpses are a -- bare name. No article == a player corpse -> don't record PK loot. local low = mob:lower() if not (low:match("^a ") or low:match("^an ") or low:match("^the ")) then return end
local citem = colored_from(styles, "You get%s+(.-)%s+from the") -- @-coded item item = base_name(item, citem) -- drop "2 * " and any bonus flag local zone, roomid, room = room_now() -- insert-if-new then bump, so it works on any SQLite version (no UPSERT needed) db:exec(string.format( "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO loot (item,item_color,mob,zone,roomid,room,count,last_seen) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%d,%s,0,%d);", q(item), q(citem), q(mob), q(zone), roomid, q(room), os.time())) db:exec(string.format( "UPDATE loot SET count=count+1, zone=%s, roomid=%d, room=%s, last_seen=%d, synced=0 WHERE item=%s AND mob=%s;", q(zone), roomid, q(room), os.time(), q(item), q(mob))) if citem ~= "" then db:exec(string.format("UPDATE loot SET item_color=%s WHERE item=%s AND mob=%s;", q(citem), q(item), q(mob))) end queue_autoid(item) end
-- native shop stock ('---' Qty). Keyed on (item, roomid) so re-listing updates price. function on_shop (name, line, wildcards, styles) local item = trim(wildcards[3]) if item == "" then return end local citem = colored_from(styles, "%-%-%-%s+(.+)$") -- @-coded item after the Qty dashes local zone, roomid, room = room_now() local lv, pr = tonumber(wildcards[1]) or 0, tonumber(wildcards[2]) or 0 db:exec(string.format( "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO shop_stock (item,item_color,keeper,zone,roomid,room,price,level,last_seen) VALUES (%s,%s,'',%s,%d,%s,%d,%d,%d);", q(item), q(citem), q(zone), roomid, q(room), pr, lv, os.time())) db:exec(string.format( "UPDATE shop_stock SET price=%d, level=%d, zone=%s, room=%s, last_seen=%d, synced=0 WHERE item=%s AND roomid=%d;", pr, lv, q(zone), q(room), os.time(), q(item), roomid)) if citem ~= "" then db:exec(string.format("UPDATE shop_stock SET item_color=%s WHERE item=%s AND roomid=%d;", q(citem), q(item), roomid)) end end
-- write one gathered row (item from a room source, keyed on item+source+room) local function record_gather (item, citem, source) item = base_name(item, citem) -- drop "2 * " and any bonus flag local zone, roomid, room = room_now() db:exec(string.format( "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO gathered (item,item_color,source,zone,roomid,room,count,last_seen) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%d,%s,0,%d);", q(item), q(citem), q(source), q(zone), roomid, q(room), os.time())) db:exec(string.format( "UPDATE gathered SET count=count+1, zone=%s, room=%s, last_seen=%d, synced=0 WHERE item=%s AND source=%s AND roomid=%d;", q(zone), q(room), os.time(), q(item), q(source), roomid)) if citem ~= "" then db:exec(string.format("UPDATE gathered SET item_color=%s WHERE item=%s AND source=%s AND roomid=%d;", q(citem), q(item), q(source), roomid)) end return roomid, zone, room end
-- 'loot here' flow: send a get, then catch its "You get <item>." to record the -- full item name (+ colour) as a floor spawn at the current room. local here_pending = false local function here_disarm () here_pending = false; EnableTrigger("here_catch", false); DeleteTimer("here_timeout") end
function on_here_catch (name, line, wildcards, styles) if not here_pending then return end local item = trim(wildcards[1]) if item:find(" from ", 1, true) then return end -- a container get slipped in; keep waiting here_disarm() if item:match("^[%d,]+ gold coins?$") then ColourNote("silver","", TITLE..": that was gold, not recorded."); return end local citem = colored_from(styles, "You get%s+(.-)%s*%.$") local roomid, _, room = record_gather(item, citem, "the ground") ColourNote("green","", "Recorded '"..item.."' on the ground in "..(room ~= "" and room or "?").." ("..roomid..").") end
function here_timeout () if here_pending then here_disarm(); ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": no pickup seen -- is the item here? Nothing recorded.") end end
-- room-resource gather: "You get <item> from <source>" where source is a room -- object (bush, chest, desk...), NOT a corpse and NOT one of your own containers. function on_get (name, line, wildcards, styles) local item, source = trim(wildcards[1]), trim(wildcards[2]) if item == "" or source == "" then return end if item:match("^[%d,]+ gold coins?$") then return end -- gold if source:lower():find("corpse", 1, true) then return end -- corpse loot handled by on_loot if my_bags[source:lower()] then return end -- a container you carry (invdata) if is_bag(source) then return end -- word-list fallback for bags record_gather(item, colored_from(styles, "You get%s+(.-)%s+from "), source) end
-- Retro-fix rows captured before variants were collapsed. Rewrites the name to its -- base form; when that collides with a row that already exists, the counts are -- folded together and the variant row goes. Touched rows go unsynced so the pool -- gets the corrected version. -- -- Note this cannot un-send the variant rows already sitting in the pool -- the API -- has no delete path. It stops us adding more of them. local function dedupe_variants () local renamed, merged = 0, 0 -- key columns that identify a row besides the item name local keyed = { loot = { "mob" }, gathered = { "source", "roomid" }, } db:exec("BEGIN") for tbl, keys in pairs(keyed) do local fixes = {} for r in db:nrows("SELECT rowid AS rid, * FROM " .. tbl) do local clean = base_name(r.item, r.item_color) if clean ~= "" and clean ~= r.item then local row = {} for _, k in ipairs(keys) do row[k] = r[k] end fixes[#fixes+1] = { rid = r.rid, clean = clean, count = r.count or 1, keys = row } end end for _, f in ipairs(fixes) do local where = "item=" .. q(f.clean) for _, k in ipairs(keys) do local v = f.keys[k] where = where .. " AND " .. k .. "=" .. (type(v) == "number" and tostring(v) or q(v)) end local exists = false for _ in db:nrows("SELECT 1 AS one FROM " .. tbl .. " WHERE " .. where) do exists = true end if exists then -- fold the variant's count into the base row, then drop the variant db:exec("UPDATE " .. tbl .. " SET count=count+" .. f.count .. ", synced=0 WHERE " .. where) db:exec("DELETE FROM " .. tbl .. " WHERE rowid=" .. f.rid) merged = merged + 1 else db:exec("UPDATE " .. tbl .. " SET item=" .. q(f.clean) .. ", synced=0 WHERE rowid=" .. f.rid) renamed = renamed + 1 end end end db:exec("COMMIT") return renamed, merged end
------------------------------------------------------------------ -- bulk appraise: "appraise 3-18" walks a shop's list numbers ------------------------------------------------------------------ -- The alias only matches a <num>-<num> range, so everything else falls straight -- through to the game: 'appraise 4' and 'appraise sword' behave exactly as before. -- -- Each appraise prints the same box the parser below already reads, so this fills -- item_stats for a whole shop in one pass. Paced one per second instead of fired in -- a burst -- 20 commands at once is command spam and Aardwolf will treat it as such. -- Stops if you go AFK partway, same rule as every other send this plugin makes. local APPRAISE_MAX = 60 -- refuse absurd ranges from a typo local APPRAISE_WAIT = 1 -- seconds between sends local appraise_q, appraise_n = {}, 0
local function arm_appraise () AddTimer("appraise_tick", 0, 0, APPRAISE_WAIT, "", timer_flag.Enabled + timer_flag.OneShot + timer_flag.Replace + timer_flag.Temporary, "appraise_tick") end
function appraise_tick () local n = table.remove(appraise_q, 1) if not n then ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": bulk appraise done ("..appraise_n.." sent).") return end if GetVariable("AFKMode") ~= nil then ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": you're flagged AFK -- bulk appraise stopped ("..(#appraise_q + 1).." left).") appraise_q = {} return end appraise_n = appraise_n + 1 Send("appraise " .. n) arm_appraise() -- next item, or the summary when the queue runs dry end
function bulk_appraise (a, b) local lo, hi = tonumber(a), tonumber(b) if not (lo and hi) then return end if lo > hi then lo, hi = hi, lo end -- 'appraise 12-1' reads fine too if lo < 1 then lo = 1 end local count = hi - lo + 1 if count > APPRAISE_MAX then ColourNote("orange","", string.format("%s: %d items is over the %d cap -- narrow the range.", TITLE, count, APPRAISE_MAX)) return end appraise_q, appraise_n = {}, 0 DeleteTimer("appraise_tick") for i = lo, hi do appraise_q[#appraise_q+1] = i end ColourNote("silver","", string.format("%s: appraising %d-%d (%d items, ~%ds). 'loot appraise stop' to halt.", TITLE, lo, hi, count, count * APPRAISE_WAIT)) appraise_tick() end
------------------------------------------------------------------ -- identify / appraise capture ------------------------------------------------------------------ -- Aardwolf prints the same boxed table for 'id', 'appraise' and a shop appraise: -- -- | Keywords : whip lash pious weapon | -- | Name : Lash of the Pious | -- | Type : Weapon Level : 131 | -- | Worth : 22,380 Weight : 1 | -- +-----------------------------------------------------------------+ -- | Weapon Type: whip Average Dam : 294 | -- +-----------------------------------------------------------------+ -- | Stat Mods : Hit roll : +13 Damage roll : +13 | -- | Strength : +1 Intelligence : +1 | -- -- Two things to watch: the mod blocks pack two "Label : +N" pairs per line and -- continue on unlabelled lines, and numbers carry commas (22,380). -- -- Nothing here sends a command. It reads boxes that already scrolled past, so -- shop 'appraise' fills the DB even without the identify wish.
local STAT_MAP = { ["Strength"] = "str", ["Intelligence"] = "intel", ["Wisdom"] = "wis", ["Dexterity"] = "dex", ["Constitution"] = "con", ["Luck"] = "luck", ["Hit points"] = "hp", ["Mana"] = "mana", ["Moves"] = "moves", ["Hit roll"] = "hit", ["Damage roll"] = "dam", ["All physical"] = "all_phys", ["All magic"] = "all_magic", ["Acid"] = "acid", ["Air"] = "air", ["Bash"] = "bash", ["Cold"] = "cold", ["Disease"] = "disease", ["Earth"] = "earth", ["Electric"] = "electric", ["Energy"] = "energy", ["Fire"] = "fire", ["Holy"] = "holy", ["Light"] = "light", ["Magic"] = "magic", ["Mental"] = "mental", ["Negative"] = "negative", ["Pierce"] = "pierce", ["Poison"] = "poison", ["Shadow"] = "shadow", ["Slash"] = "slash", ["Sonic"] = "sonic", ["Water"] = "water", }
-- text columns; everything else in item_stats is numeric local STAT_TEXT = { item = true, item_color = true, keywords = true, type = true, wearable = true, material = true, flags = true, found_at = true, clan_item = true, owned_by = true, leads_to = true, notes = true, weapon_type = true, specials = true, inflicts = true, dam_type = true, spells = true, }
-- one "Label : value" per box row, mapped to its column local ID_FIELDS = { ["Keywords"] = "keywords", ["Type"] = "type", ["Worth"] = "worth", ["Weight"] = "weight", ["Level"] = "level", ["Score"] = "score", ["Wearable"] = "wearable", ["Material"] = "material", ["Flags"] = "flags", ["Found at"] = "found_at", ["Clan Item"] = "clan_item", ["Owned By"] = "owned_by", ["Leads to"] = "leads_to", ["Weapon Type"] = "weapon_type", ["Average Dam"] = "ave_dam", ["Specials"] = "specials", ["Inflicts"] = "inflicts", ["Damage Type"] = "dam_type", ["Capacity"] = "capacity", }
local idrec = nil -- row being built, nil when not inside a box local id_mod_block = nil -- "stat" while a Stat/Resist Mods continuation may follow
local function num (s) return tonumber((tostring(s or ""):gsub(",", ""))) end
-- "Label : +3 Other : -2" -> set both columns. Also handles the unlabelled -- continuation rows, which are just more pairs. local function id_mods (text) for label, sign, digits in text:gmatch("([A-Za-z][A-Za-z ]-)%s*:%s*([%+%-])(%d+)") do local col = STAT_MAP[trim(label)] if col then idrec[col] = tonumber(sign .. digits) end end end
function on_id_start (name, line, wildcards, styles) idrec = { full_id = 1 } id_mod_block = nil idrec.keywords = trim(wildcards[1]) EnableTrigger("id_line", true) EnableTrigger("id_end", true) end
function on_id_line (name, line, wildcards, styles) if not idrec then return end local body = wildcards[1] or ""
-- Name carries the item's colour, so pull it from the styles run local nm = body:match("^%s*Name%s+:%s*(.-)%s*|?%s*$") if nm then idrec.item = trim(nm) idrec.item_color = colored_from(styles, "Name@?%a?%s+:%s*(.-)%s*@?%a?|") if idrec.item_color == "" then idrec.item_color = nil end id_mod_block = nil return end
-- Stat Mods / Resist Mods open a block that continues on unlabelled rows local mods = body:match("^%s*Stat Mods%s*:(.*)$") or body:match("^%s*Resist Mods%s*:(.*)$") if mods then id_mods(mods) id_mod_block = "stat" return end -- an unlabelled row while a mod block is open is a continuation if id_mod_block and body:match("^%s+[A-Za-z][A-Za-z ]-%s*:%s*[%+%-]%d") then id_mods(body) return end
-- Notes repeats; keep them joined rather than clobbering local note = body:match("^%s*Notes%s+:%s*(.-)%s*|?%s*$") if note and note ~= "" then idrec.notes = (idrec.notes and (idrec.notes .. "; ") or "") .. note id_mod_block = nil return end
-- Spells can list several uses; join them too local sp = body:match("^%s*Spells%s+:%s*(.-)%s*|?%s*$") if sp and sp ~= "" then idrec.spells = (idrec.spells and (idrec.spells .. "; ") or "") .. sp id_mod_block = nil return end
-- plain "Label : value" pairs. Rows pack two of them ("Type : Weapon Level : 131"), -- so a value can't run to the next colon or it swallows the following label. Walk the -- colons instead: a label is the text since the last run of 2+ spaces (real labels -- like "Weapon Type" use single spaces, column padding is always wider), and a value -- runs from its colon to where the next label starts. local found = {} local pos = 1 while true do local c = body:find(":", pos, true) if not c then break end local pre = body:sub(1, c - 1):gsub("%s+$", "") local lstart, scan = 1, 1 while true do local a, b = pre:find("%s%s+", scan) if not a then break end lstart, scan = b + 1, b + 1 end found[#found+1] = { label = trim(pre:sub(lstart)), lstart = lstart, vstart = c + 1 } pos = c + 1 end
local hit = false for i, p in ipairs(found) do local col = ID_FIELDS[p.label] if col then local vend = found[i+1] and (found[i+1].lstart - 1) or #body local v = trim((body:sub(p.vstart, vend):gsub("|%s*$", ""))) if v ~= "" then idrec[col] = STAT_TEXT[col] and v or num(v) hit = true end end end if hit then id_mod_block = nil end end
local function id_store () local r = idrec idrec, id_mod_block = nil, nil EnableTrigger("id_line", false) EnableTrigger("id_end", false) if not r or not r.item or r.item == "" then return end
r.last_id = os.time() local cols, vals, sets = {}, {}, {} for k, v in pairs(r) do local lit = STAT_TEXT[k] and q(v) or tostring(v) cols[#cols+1] = k vals[#vals+1] = lit if k ~= "item" then sets[#sets+1] = k .. ------------------------------------------------------------------ -- command dispatch ------------------------------------------------------------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------ -- share the DB out-of-band (file), so clans can pool data with zero game traffic ------------------------------------------------------------------ local SHARE_COLS = { loot = {"item","item_color","mob","zone","roomid","room","count","last_seen"}, shop_stock = {"item","item_color","keeper","zone","roomid","room","price","level","last_seen"}, gathered = {"item","item_color","source","zone","roomid","room","count","last_seen"}, item_stats = {"item","item_color","keywords","type","level","worth","weight","score", "wearable","material","flags","found_at","clan_item","owned_by","leads_to", "notes","weapon_type","ave_dam","specials","inflicts","dam_type","spells", "capacity","str","intel","wis","dex","con","luck","hp","mana","moves", "hit","dam","all_phys","all_magic","acid","air","bash","cold","disease", "earth","electric","energy","fire","holy","light","magic","mental", "negative","pierce","poison","shadow","slash","sonic","water", "full_id","last_id"}, } local SHARE_ORDER = { "loot", "shop_stock", "gathered", "item_stats" }
-- serialize the whole DB to the shared TSV format (also the HTTP wire body) -- serialize the whole DB to a JSON object: { <table> = [ {col=val,...}, ... ], ... } -- this is both the file format and the HTTP wire body. local function serialize_db () local data, rows = {}, 0 for _, tbl in ipairs(SHARE_ORDER) do local cols, arr = SHARE_COLS[tbl], {} for r in db:nrows("SELECT "..table.concat(cols, ",").." FROM "..tbl) do local o = {} for _, c in ipairs(cols) do o[c] = r[c] end arr[#arr+1] = o; rows = rows + 1 end data[tbl] = arr end return json.encode(data), rows end
-- Merge a shared JSON dump into the DB (existing rows kept). Returns added, seen. -- -- from_pool matters for the sync flag. Rows pulled from the API are already in the -- pool, so they land synced and the next upload won't ship everyone else's data -- back. Rows from a clanmate's file are NOT necessarily in the pool, so they land -- unsynced and get contributed on the next upload. local function merge_dump (text, from_pool) local ok, data = pcall(json.decode, tostring(text or "")) if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0, 0 end local flag = from_pool and "1" or "0" local before, seen = db:total_changes(), 0 db:exec("BEGIN") for _, tbl in ipairs(SHARE_ORDER) do local cols, arr = SHARE_COLS[tbl], data[tbl] if type(arr) == "table" then for _, o in ipairs(arr) do if type(o) == "table" then local qs = {} for _, c in ipairs(cols) do local v = o[c]; qs[#qs+1] = q(v == nil and "" or v) end db:exec("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO "..tbl.." ("..table.concat(cols, ",")..",synced) VALUES ("..table.concat(qs, ",")..","..flag..")") seen = seen + 1 end end end end db:exec("COMMIT") return db:total_changes() - before, seen end
local function do_export (fn) fn = trim(fn); if fn == "" then fn = "SolaoLoot-share.json" end local path = GetInfo(66) .. fn local f = io.open(path, "w") if not f then ColourNote("red","", TITLE..": can't write "..path); return end local body, rows = serialize_db() f:write(body); f:close() ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": exported "..rows.." rows -> "..path) ColourNote("silver","", "Share that file out-of-band (Discord / git). Others: loot import "..fn) end
local function do_import (fn) fn = trim(fn) if fn == "" then ColourNote("silver","","Usage: loot import <file> (merge a shared export; existing rows kept)"); return end local f = io.open(GetInfo(66) .. fn, "r") if not f then ColourNote("red","", TITLE..": can't read "..fn); return end local text = f:read("*a"); f:close() local added, seen = merge_dump(text, false) ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": imported "..fn.." -- "..added.." new row(s) ("..seen.." read, duplicates kept).") end
------------------------------------------------------------------ -- shared API service (default off). 'loot api <url>' sets the endpoint, then -- 'loot auth' registers this character and stores the key (never shown). upload -- pushes your DB; update pulls + merges the pool. Straight HTTP, no game traffic. -- POST <api>/auth JSON {"name":..} -> JSON {"key":.., "name":..} -- POST <api>/loot x-api-key, JSON dump -> server merges it in -- GET <api>/loot x-api-key -> JSON pooled dump -- (JSON body shape: { loot=[{col:val,..},..], shop_stock=[..], gathered=[..] }) -- On a 401 from /loot the key is dead: re-auth ONCE and retry ONCE. Never re-auth -- on any other status -- each /auth mints a NEW account (name may get a -2 suffix), -- so careless re-registration would fragment one player across many accounts. ------------------------------------------------------------------ local function api_url () return API_URL end local function auth_key () return trim(GetVariable("authkey") or "") end
local function need_api () if api_url() == "" then ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": sharing is disabled in this build."); return false end if not async then ColourNote("red","", TITLE..": async library missing; can't reach the API."); return false end return true end local function need_auth () if auth_key() == "" then ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": not authenticated -- run 'loot auth' first."); return false end return true end
-- POST /auth for `name`; store the key AND the name the server returns (it may add -- a -N suffix if the name is taken). cb(true/false). local function register (name, cb) local body = json.encode({ name = name }) local req = { method = "POST", source = body, headers = { ["content-type"] = "application/json", ["content-length"] = tostring(#body) } } async.doAsyncRemoteRequest(api_url().."/auth", function (rc, page, status) local key, rname if type(page) == "string" then local ok, t = pcall(json.decode, page) if ok and type(t) == "table" then key = t.key; rname = t.name end end if status == 200 and key and trim(key) ~= "" then SetVariable("authkey", trim(key)) -- hidden; never displayed SetVariable("authname", trim(rname or name)) -- store what the server gave back if cb then cb(true) end elseif status == 429 then ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": auth rate-limited (429) -- wait a while before trying again.") if cb then cb(false) end else ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": auth failed (status "..tostring(status)..").") if cb then cb(false) end end end, nil, 30, nil, req) end
-- key got a 401: throw it away and register fresh under the real character name local function reauth (cb) local name = trim(gmcp("char.base.name") or "") if name == "" then name = trim(GetVariable("authname") or "") end if name == "" then ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": key rejected and no character name to re-auth with -- run 'loot auth'.") if cb then cb(false) end; return end SetVariable("authkey", "") -- discard the dead key first ColourNote("silver","", TITLE..": key was rejected, re-registering '"..name.."'...") register(name, cb) end
-- run a /loot request; on 401 re-auth once then retry once, then give up local function loot_request (method, body, on_ok, retried) local req = { method = method, headers = { ["x-api-key"] = auth_key() } } if body then req.source = body req.headers["content-type"] = "application/json" req.headers["content-length"] = tostring(#body) end async.doAsyncRemoteRequest(api_url().."/loot", function (rc, page, status) if status == 401 and not retried then reauth(function (ok) if ok then loot_request(method, body, on_ok, true) else ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": sync aborted -- couldn't get a valid key.") end end) elseif status == 401 then ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": still unauthorized after re-auth -- try again later.") else on_ok(rc, page, status) end end, nil, 60, nil, req) end
-- register this character with the pool; the API returns a key we store hidden local function do_auth () if auth_key() ~= "" then ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": already authenticated as "..(GetVariable("authname") or "?")..".") return end if not need_api() then return end local name = trim(gmcp("char.base.name") or "") if name == "" then name = trim(utils.inputbox("Character name to register with the loot pool:", TITLE, "") or "") end if name == "" then ColourNote("silver","", TITLE..": auth cancelled."); return end ColourNote("silver","", TITLE..": registering '"..name.."'...") register(name, function (ok) if ok then ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": authenticated as "..(GetVariable("authname") or name)..". 'loot upload' / 'loot update' are ready.") end end) end
-- Upload in slices, capped by BYTES not row count. -- -- The whole DB in one POST was ~144KB and never arrived: the body is handed to a -- background thread and pushed through LuaSocket, and past roughly one socket -- buffer (~64KB) fewer bytes reach the wire than content-length advertises, so the -- server sits waiting for a body that never finishes. Staying well under that -- boundary avoids it entirely. A row cap alone wouldn't -- one item with a long -- notes/flags field could blow the budget -- so slices are cut on encoded size. local MAX_BODY = 32768 -- hard ceiling per POST, half a socket buffer local UPLOAD_READ = 200 -- rows to consider per slice
-- how many rows in `tbl` the pool hasn't seen in their current form local function pending_of (tbl) for r in db:nrows("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "..tbl.." WHERE synced=0") do return r.n end return 0 end local function pending_all () local n = 0 for _, t in ipairs(SHARE_ORDER) do n = n + pending_of(t) end return n end
-- The next unsynced slice of `tbl`, taking as many rows as fit in MAX_BODY. -- Returns body, rowid list. No OFFSET needed: a sent row gets marked synced, so -- it drops out of this query and the next call naturally sees the following rows. -- That makes a half-finished upload resume exactly where it stopped. -- Each row is encoded on its own and joined, so the length we measure is the -- length we send -- no second encoding pass to drift away from content-length. local function serialize_slice (tbl) local cols = SHARE_COLS[tbl] local parts, ids, bytes = {}, {}, 0 for r in db:nrows("SELECT rowid AS rid,"..table.concat(cols, ",").." FROM "..tbl .." WHERE synced=0 ORDER BY rowid LIMIT "..UPLOAD_READ) do local o = {} for _, c in ipairs(cols) do o[c] = r[c] end local enc = json.encode(o) -- always take at least one row, even if that row is enormous on its own if #ids > 0 and (bytes + #enc) > MAX_BODY then break end parts[#parts+1] = enc ids[#ids+1] = r.rid bytes = bytes + #enc + 1 end if #ids == 0 then return nil, nil end return '{"'..tbl..'":['..table.concat(parts, ",")..']}', ids end
local function mark_synced (tbl, ids) db:exec("UPDATE "..tbl.." SET synced=1 WHERE rowid IN ("..table.concat(ids, ",")..")") end
-- Deltas are cheap but they only declare what changed, and the pool's "how many -- players have this item" counter learns from what you declare. Skip that forever -- and you never register on the 400 items you already share with everyone. So -- re-declare the whole DB on a slow cadence, deltas in between. local FULL_EVERY = 7 * 86400 -- a week local function full_due () return (os.time() - (tonumber(GetVariable("lastfull")) or 0)) >= FULL_EVERY end
local function do_upload (force_full) if not (need_api() and need_auth()) then return end
local full = force_full or full_due() if full then -- re-declare everything; still goes out in the same size-capped batches for _, t in ipairs(SHARE_ORDER) do db:exec("UPDATE "..t.." SET synced=0;") end end
local grand = pending_all() if grand == 0 then ColourNote("silver","", TITLE..": nothing new to upload -- the pool already has everything here.") return end ColourNote("silver","", TITLE..": uploading "..grand..(full and " rows (full re-declare)" or " new/changed rows").."...")
local ti, sent, batch = 1, 0, 0 local function step () -- move past tables with nothing pending while ti <= #SHARE_ORDER and pending_of(SHARE_ORDER[ti]) == 0 do ti = ti + 1 end if ti > #SHARE_ORDER then -- only stamp a full declare once it actually finished, so an aborted one -- gets retried rather than counting as this week's if full then SetVariable("lastfull", tostring(os.time())) end ColourNote("green","", string.format("%s: upload ok -- %d rows in %d batches.%s", TITLE, sent, batch, full and " (full re-declare)" or "")) return end
local tbl = SHARE_ORDER[ti] local body, ids = serialize_slice(tbl) if not body then ti = ti + 1; step(); return end batch = batch + 1 local n = #ids loot_request("POST", body, function (rc, page, status) if status == 200 then mark_synced(tbl, ids) -- only after the server confirms it sent = sent + n ColourNote("silver","", string.format("%s: %s +%d (%d/%d)", TITLE, tbl, n, sent, grand)) step() elseif status == 408 then -- server stopped seeing body bytes: transport, not auth. Nothing is -- marked, so re-running picks up exactly these rows again. ColourNote("orange","", string.format("%s: batch %d (%s) stalled in transit (408). %d rows are in; run 'loot upload' again to resume.", TITLE, batch, tbl, sent)) else ColourNote("orange","", string.format("%s: upload stopped at batch %d (%s) -- status %s. %d rows are in; run 'loot upload' again to resume.", TITLE, batch, tbl, tostring(status), sent)) end end) end step() end
local function do_update () if not (need_api() and need_auth()) then return end ColourNote("silver","", TITLE..": fetching the shared pool...") loot_request("GET", nil, function (rc, page, status) if status == 200 and type(page) == "string" then local added, seen = merge_dump(page, true) ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": update ok -- "..added.." new row(s) ("..seen.." read).") else ColourNote("orange","", TITLE..": update failed (status "..tostring(status)..").") end end) end
function lt_cmd (arg) arg = trim(arg) local verb, rest = arg:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)$") verb = (verb or ""):lower()
if verb == "" or verb == "status" then ColourNote("cyan","", TITLE.." v"..PVER) ColourNote("white","", " loot rows : "..count_of("loot")) ColourNote("white","", " shop rows : "..count_of("shop_stock")) ColourNote("white","", " gathered : "..count_of("gathered")) ColourNote("white","", " id'd items: "..count_of("item_stats").." (auto-id "..(cfg_autoid and "on" or "off")..")") local pend = pending_all() ColourNote(pend > 0 and "yellow" or "green","", " to sync : "..pend..(pend > 0 and " ('loot upload')" or " (pool is current)"))
elseif verb == "item" then show_item(rest) elseif verb == "mob" then show_mob(rest) elseif verb == "shop" then show_shop(rest) elseif verb == "stats" or verb == "stat" then show_stats(rest)
-- send an identify and let the box parser catch it elseif verb == "id" then local kw = trim(rest) if kw == "" then ColourNote("silver","","Usage: loot id <keyword> (or 'loot autoid on|off')"); return end Send("id " .. kw)
elseif verb == "autoid" then local s = trim(rest):lower() if s == "on" then cfg_autoid = true; SetVariable("autoid", "1") ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": auto-identify on loot is ON. Needs the identify wish to return full stats.") elseif s == "off" then cfg_autoid = false; SetVariable("autoid", "0") ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": auto-identify on loot is off.") else ColourNote("cyan","", TITLE..": auto-identify is "..(cfg_autoid and "ON" or "off")..". 'loot autoid on|off'") ColourNote("silver","","Appraise and manual 'id' are always captured -- this only controls sending 'id' for you.") end

elseif verb == "appraise" then local sub = trim(rest):lower() local lo, hi = sub:match("^(%d+)%s*%-%s*(%d+)$") if sub == "stop" then local left = #appraise_q appraise_q = {} DeleteTimer("appraise_tick") ColourNote(left > 0 and "orange" or "silver","", TITLE..": bulk appraise " ..(left > 0 and ("stopped, "..left.." unsent.") or "wasn't running.")) elseif lo then bulk_appraise(lo, hi) else ColourNote("silver","","Usage: appraise <first>-<last> (e.g. appraise 1-12) | loot appraise stop") end
elseif verb == "dedupe" then local renamed, merged = dedupe_variants() if renamed + merged == 0 then ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": nothing to collapse -- no variant rows found.") else ColourNote("green","", string.format("%s: collapsed %d variant row(s) -- %d renamed, %d merged into an existing row. elseif verb == "flags" then local sub, w = rest:match("^(%S*)%s*(.*)$") sub, w = (sub or ""):lower(), trim(w):lower():gsub("[%(%)]", "") if sub == "add" and w ~= "" then bonus_flags[w] = true; save_flags(); ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": '"..w.."' is a bonus flag.") elseif sub == "del" and w ~= "" then bonus_flags[w] = nil; save_flags(); ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": '"..w.."' is no longer treated as a bonus flag.") else local t = {}; for f in pairs(bonus_flags) do t[#t+1] = f end table.sort(t) ColourNote("cyan","","Bonus-loot flags stripped from loot/gathered names ("..#t.."):") ColourNote("white",""," "..table.concat(t, ", ")) ColourNote("silver","","Only stripped when the bracket colour matches a bonus tier.") ColourNote("silver","","loot flags add <word> | loot flags del <word>") end elseif verb == "recent" then show_recent() elseif verb == "export" then do_export(rest) elseif verb == "import" then do_import(rest) elseif verb == "auth" then do_auth() elseif verb == "upload" then do_upload(trim(rest):lower() == "full") elseif verb == "update" then do_update() elseif verb == "api" then ColourNote("cyan","", TITLE..": API = "..(api_url() ~= "" and api_url() or "(disabled in this build)")) ColourNote("white","", " auth : "..(auth_key() ~= "" and ("yes, as "..(GetVariable("authname") or "?")) or "no -- run 'loot auth'")) for _, t in ipairs(SHARE_ORDER) do ColourNote("white","", string.format(" %-11s %d of %d to sync", t, pending_of(t), count_of(t))) end local lf = tonumber(GetVariable("lastfull")) or 0 ColourNote("white","", " full declare: "..(lf > 0 and os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", lf) or "never") ..(full_due() and " (due -- next upload re-declares all)" or ""))

SET synced=0;") end ColourNote("green","", TITLE..": all rows marked unsynced -- 'loot upload' will re-send everything.") end
elseif verb == "clear" then if rest == "loot" then db:exec("DELETE FROM loot;"); ColourNote("green","","Loot table cleared.") elseif rest == "shop" then db:exec("DELETE FROM shop_stock;"); ColourNote("green","","Shop table cleared.") elseif rest == "gathered" then db:exec("DELETE FROM gathered;"); ColourNote("green","","Gathered table cleared.") elseif rest == "stats" then db:exec("DELETE FROM item_stats;"); ColourNote("green","","Item stats cleared.") else ColourNote("silver","","Type 'loot clear loot|shop|gathered|stats'.") end
else ColourNote("cyan","", TITLE.." v"..PVER) for _, l in ipairs({ " loot - row counts", " loot item <text> - where an item drops from (mob / zone / room)", " loot mob <text> - what a mob drops", " loot shop <text> - which shops natively stock an item (price / zone)", " loot gathered <text> - where a room resource (bush/chest/...) is picked up", " loot stats <text> - stat block for an item (level/mods/resists/weapon)", " loot id <keyword> - identify an item and store its stats", " loot autoid on|off - auto-identify freshly looted gear (needs identify wish)", " loot idnote on|off - confirm each stat capture on screen", " loot here <keyword>- get a room-floor spawn and record its full name/colour", " loot del <item> [roomid] - remove matching rows (roomid scopes to one room)", " loot bags [add|del <word>] - container words ignored for gathers", " loot flags [add|del <word>] - bonus-loot flags stripped from names", " loot dedupe - collapse variant rows already captured", " appraise <a>-<b> - appraise a range of shop list numbers, paced", " loot appraise stop - halt a running bulk appraise", " loot recent - last 15 things looted", " loot export [file] - dump the DB to a file to share (no game traffic)", " loot import <file> - merge a shared export (existing rows kept)", " loot api - endpoint, auth status, per-table sync backlog", " loot resync yes - forget sync flags; re-send everything next upload", " loot auth - register this character with the pool (one time)", " loot upload - push new/changed rows to the pool (needs auth)", " loot upload full - re-declare every row now (weekly on its own)", " loot update - pull + merge the shared pool (needs auth)", " loot clear loot|shop|gathered|stats - wipe a table", " loot help - this", "Records every item you loot off a corpse, and native shop stock ('---'", "qty) when you 'list'. Any identify or appraise box that scrolls past is", "parsed for stats too, so shop appraises fill the DB with no wish needed.", "SolaoBot reads this DB for 'solbot item <name>'.", }) do ColourNote("white","", l) end end end
